comment.text: EPHA7 G656 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include CNS tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cnsbrain; Head and neck tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: headandneck; Skin tumors. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.
